reference.dataset: Mendeley Data bvwh9d6227: Grid-India NERLDC PMU one-second frequency, shared by IIT Guwahati, CC BY 4.0

credit.text: Mukherjee, D., Kalita, K., Kumar, S.: PMU-Frequency Data at 1-second Interval (December 2020- July 2024). Mendeley Data, version 4, CC BY 4.0 (2024).
credit.changes: The CSV files were merged into one one-second series (scripts/build_reference.py), and the explorer shows it downsampled: 60-minute ranges along the whole span, and steps of 2 to 3 s around each clip (scripts/export_site_data.py).

ribbon.units: mHz relative to 50 Hz (integer); null = under half of the hour valid

drift.method: For each file and each window of 7 days: mean |f(t)-f(t-1)| folded on the label t mod 900 s (the 15-minute scheduling block). Circular cross-correlation with a template (mean of aligned windows, phase anchored to the first window of each file) gives each window's shift, in seconds; r is the profile correlation at that shift. Positive shift = the block features sit later on that file's labels. The check is relative: it assumes each file's first window is on time.
drift.stable_rule: label-stable if the drift window's profile correlation r is at least 0.5 (PROTOCOL section 6)

uniqueness.label: SYNTHETIC noise simulation on the reference only. No audio.
noise_labels: SYNTHETIC noise added to real reference excerpt

v1.status: latency not calibrated (fewer than 3 streams count)

naive.status: latency not calibrated (fewer than 3 streams count)

latency.rule: counted: confidence at or above tau (60 min, ±1 day) and |o| at most 600 s; L = median of counted o

tau.rule: m = floor(0.01 n); tau = (m+1)-th largest threshold-half confidence + 0.0001 (PROTOCOL.md section 10). Trials with no runner-up count in n as no verdict.

calibration.note: Calibration streams set L, so the within-30-s counts are in-sample.

dev.objective: mean over Dev stream x length cells of clip(atanh(r_true) - atanh(r_other), -1, 1)

hero.why: highest confidence among the 4 Calibration streams whose 60-min v2 excerpt has a match verdict (hum flag set, confidence at or above tau) within 30 s of T* in the ±1-day scope
hero.split_note: Calibration split: used only to estimate the latency L (PROTOCOL section 6). Its errors are not an independent test.

hum.rule: hum flag: any harmonic's median peak-to-floor ratio is 3 or more

1d.verdict_reason: hum flag set and confidence at or above tau
1d.source: recomputed by scripts/export_site_data.py with gunj.match_v2.wncc_search; checked against results/calibration.json

full.verdict_reason: hum flag set and confidence at or above tau
full.source: computed by scripts/export_site_data.py: gunj.match_v2.wncc_search on traces/calibration/aTL452sxXOA.npz (v2__x60) over the whole reference. This display search is not part of any pre-registered metric.

truth.rule: T* = release time in IST + L + D (PROTOCOL section 6); e = top candidate start - T*
truth.in_sample_note: L was estimated from the Calibration split, so e here is not an independent test.

test.latency_line: L = 2 s (calibrated; `results/latency.json`). T* = release time in IST + L + D.

flow.step: match (v2, any length, full or +-90 d)

counts.rule: M1: Test streams with audio whose v1 hum flag on all downloaded audio is set. S2: label-stable streams. S3: channels whose official status was verified at the metadata step. Paired: the same streams, top-1 within 30 s (v2, 60 min, full span).

classes.no_candidate: the search could not run; no top-1 candidate

breakdown.checked: every v2 cell recounted from results/test_results.csv (verdict, hit_30s, hit_120s, hit_600s) and equal to the file

m5.label: SYNTHETIC
m5.note: Every cut is SYNTHETIC: a stretch removed from the 60-min excerpt audio with gunj.synthetic.cut_audio at harvest time. Positions are seconds into the excerpt, which starts 120 s into the recording.
m5.stream_rule: Test streams whose uncut 60-min excerpt is a confident hit in the full scope (extractor v2; results table)
m5.checked: its 14 streams are the confident hits of v2, 60 min, full span in results/test_results.csv

m4_measured.label: SYNTHETIC noise on real reference excerpts, read at the noise measured on the Test streams that lock

reading_labels.B: pre-registered: the computation of scripts/probe_noise.py (plain Pearson r of the trace with the window it matched, plain std s of that window)
reading_labels.A: EXPLORATORY (post hoc): r1 as scored by the frozen evaluation (v2's weighted correlation) in the same formula, with the plain s

m4_measured.what: Equivalent trace noise of the Test streams that lock (PROTOCOL.md section 11, M4), computed as in scripts/probe_noise.py, and the uniqueness table (SYNTHETIC noise on real reference excerpts) read at that level by linear interpolation between the pre-set levels.
m4_measured.reading_A: r = r1 recorded by the frozen evaluation (results/search_cache/test; v2 weighted correlation)
m4_measured.reading_B: r = unweighted Pearson correlation of the same v2 trace with the same reference window
m4_measured.per_stream_rule: median over the stream's locking excerpts (one excerpt per length; a lock in the full or +-90-day scope)

m2.display_rule: linear for |e| <= 30.5 s, then one unit per decade

m3.display_rule: linear on [0, 0.025], then one unit per doubling (scripts/make_figures.py conf_pos)

libhum.reason: libhum was never installed, and the time went to the harvest problems recorded above.
